objective: 实现 provider-neutral、同步、纯函数的 Fast Container resolution 与 derived trust seam，复用已验证语义 evidence 和 V2 Graph/current refs，不接入 Agent 行为

semantic_brief.summary: Buyer：Phase 2.6 blocker migration 与 BGE 结果支持受控 Fast experiment。Fast 组合 action prior、fresh Slice、已验证 semantic support、Graph prior 与 hard conflict，输出 revision-bound working assessment，不产生 truth 或 action authority。

anchors.symbol: DeviceAction.Tap / SetSwitch / ScrollForward / ScrollBackward / SystemBack / LaunchApp

change_principles: 先搜索 existing Fast/provider/fusion/resolver/action-prior symbols并在结果中给出REUSE/EXTEND/REFACTOR/CREATE裁决
World实现必须static/pure或无状态；不得存储latest assessment/trust/current/graph/provider结果
request只接受immutable refs、fresh evidence revision、bounded action prior、semantic support、Graph candidate和hard conflict
复用SemanticEvidence或V2 admitted evidence的引用/候选职责；不得新建vector、embedding、retrieval、provider或semantic admission pipeline
action prior仅表达MAY_ENTER/MAY_RETURN/STRONG_SAME/MAY_EXTERNAL/UNKNOWN，不得直接决定结果
hard conflict必须压过support；无fresh evidence或证据不足必须AMBIGUOUS/ABSTAIN
Fast Trust只能是assessment派生属性，不得成为mutable field、Action/Goal/Completion/Memory输入
你不是仓库唯一执行者；不得回退或覆盖他人/用户修改，发现scope文件并发变化则停止上报Leader
acceptance: WorkResult列出搜索证据并解释为何existing IContainerIdentityEvidenceFusion不能直接承担action+Graph+boundary working assessment；REUSE优先，若新建IFastContainerResolver必须有test fake/replacement seam buyer与NEW_SYMBOL_JUSTIFICATION
生产文件定义最小action prior、revision-bound request、SAME/NEW/TRANSIENT/AMBIGUOUS assessment、derived FastTrust和resolver seam；无provider/backend或Agent integration
测试覆盖Tap MAY_ENTER+fresh independent+semantic support=>NEW/FAST_TRUSTED，Scroll或Toggle strong SAME+continuity=>SAME，transient evidence=>TRANSIENT，证据不足=>AMBIGUOUS
测试覆盖hard conflict precedence、action prior alone不成truth、Graph prior alone不成truth、semantic similarity/vector candidate不成truth、stale/mismatched revision fail-closed
测试覆盖trigger-destination support但不等于identity truth，并证明resolver abstain时无Graph/Current mutation
架构Guard证明无DeviceAction dispatch、ActionResult、Goal/Plan/Recovery/Completion/Memory/Agent/DriverHost/provider callback或mutable static/instance state
targeted Fast resolver+existing Fast semantic+V2 core+legacy transition tests通过；Runtime Rebuild与git diff --check通过
forbidden: 禁止修改 OpenSpec、docs、WorkItem、tasks checkbox或 scope.write 之外任何文件
禁止修改现有 Semantic provider/fusion/vector/BGE、Agent、Container、DriverHost、Traversal、Recovery、Environment 或 GoalEvidence
禁止创建第二套 semantic evidence/admission/vector/retrieval abstraction
禁止把 Fast assessment 写入 ContainerRuntimeV2State/Graph/CurrentContainer/WorldBelief 或任何 mutable owner
禁止把 FAST_TRUSTED 用作 action authorization、completion、Slow confirmation或memory publication
禁止场景字符串特判、放宽fail-closed或删除测试取得GREEN
escalation: 若现有 semantic evidence 无法表达所需支持而必须修改其 graduated contract，返回 BLOCKED_FOR_ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW，不扩scope
若 action prior 映射必须读取 Agent dispatch context，先保留typed prior input并返回后续 integration buyer，不修改Agent
若 resolver 必须持有mutable state/provider callback或改变Runtime authority，返回 REQUIRED_HUMAN_GATE
若scope文件存在不明并发修改或失败指向scope外，保留现场并返回Expected/Observed/Gap/FirstDivergence/Owner
